result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): B has a minute-by-minute clock table, so a nervous caller can find their place quickly. It is also much more specific to construction subcontractors, covering retainage, lien waivers, over/under billing, certified payroll and construction software. A is tight and does better on deciding who is involved and setting a dated next step, but its content is more generic and it leaves out retainage and progress billing. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): A is much more specific to subcontractor bookkeeping. It covers retainage, lien waivers, WIP and over/under billing, certified payroll and construction software, and its minute-marked clock table makes it easy to find your place mid-call. B is stronger on sizing the pain in numbers (hours, days, bank issues) and on naming who else decides, but most of its content is generic sales advice that barely touches subcontractor specifics. A's pain section misses owner hours and lender or tax issues, and its close only briefly covers who attends, but its overall fit to the request is better.
